# Version 4.151.0
> **Raster and shaping efficiency** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap rendering performance and reduces parsing and shaping overhead.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remove whitespace immediately after the color prefix** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after # in six- or eight-digit input. Remove that inner whitespace before parsing; surrounding whitespace and case-insensitive hexadecimal input remain supported. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia m151** — Updates the bundled engine to milestone 151 without changing the native C API. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Parse buffer slices directly** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag, avoiding substring allocation and reducing parsing overhead. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU bitmap performance restored** — Restores the optimized CPU path for scaled and tiled bitmaps that regressed after Skia m146. Color conversion and single-value premultiply/unpremultiply also avoid per-color native calls while preserving results. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428), [#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Ganesh text and stencil stability** — Corrects malformed native text-resource cleanup, native-coordinate stencil tracking, preserve-mode stencil clearing, and resolve dirty tracking after failed work. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Less shaping allocation and prompt image cleanup** — SKShaper reads glyph results through zero-copy spans, HarfBuzz UTF-8 string input uses pooled encoding, and subset image decoding promptly disposes an intermediate image when a new subset is returned. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly archives** — Supplies Emscripten 5.0.6 native assets with the new exception-handling instructions required by .NET 11 preview 6 and later in this release. .NET 8, 9, and 10 retain their existing toolchain mappings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Buffer.AddUtf8(string) uses pooled encoding, and Tag.Parse accepts ReadOnlySpan<char> without its former scratch-array work. HarfBuzz WebAssembly assets add the Emscripten 5.0.6 toolchain for .NET 11.
